findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "data-quality" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: data-quality_csv-normalize · Private data: data-quality_csv-schema-detect, data-quality_csv-profile, data-quality_csv-column-type-detect, data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit, data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect, data-quality_csv-outlier-detect, data-quality_csv-normalize, data-quality_csv-report · Public sink: data-quality_csv-normalize · Destructive: data-quality_csv-schema-detect, data-quality_csv-profile, data-quality_csv-column-type-detect, data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit, data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect, data-quality_csv-outlier-detect, data-quality_csv-normalize, data-quality_csv-report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: data-quality_csv-normalize · Private data: data-quality_csv-schema-detect, data-quality_csv-profile, data-quality_csv-column-type-detect, data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit, data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect, data-quality_csv-outlier-detect, data-quality_csv-normalize, data-quality_csv-report · Public sink: data-quality_csv-normalize · Destructive: data-quality_csv-schema-detect, data-quality_csv-profile, data-quality_csv-column-type-detect, data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit, data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect, data-quality_csv-outlier-detect, data-quality_csv-normalize, data-quality_csv-report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
